messages:
elaine-finance: Acquirer notified us of a chargeback for acct_9901. Cardholder claims charges were unauthorized; payouts on hold. Need evidence packet + advice.

trevor-payments: Which txns/timeframe? I can grab auth logs and AVS/CVV.

elaine-finance: TX-7788, TX-7790 on 2026-03-28 17:22-17:35 UTC. Total $1,350. Billing contact billing@hexapi.ai.

fraud-alert-bot: ALERT: score=0.86, velocity=HIGH, ip_vpn=TRUE, device_fingerprint_change=2. Recommend HOLD + EVIDENCE_SUBMIT.

maya-cs: Customer replied: "Not ours, refund please." They already contacted their bank.

trevor-payments: Quick artifact list: masked_pan **** **** **** 6666; TX-7788 $600, TX-7790 $750. Uploading logs to secure S3.

sylvie-legal: Redact PAN, include itemized invoices, login IPs, session timestamps, and any 2FA events. Do not include CVV. Confirm we have consent to log IPs.

elaine-finance: Notes: account auto-renewed and shows an unusual burst of long-running jobs right before charges. Owner last active 03-25.

trevor-payments: Uploaded evidence bundle (redacted) to internal S3 and started representment draft. My read: moderate chance to contest given VPN + geo jumps, but submit with all logs.

maya-cs: I offered a $300 courtesy credit if customer agrees in writing to pause dispute. They said they will consider if we can resolve quickly.

sylvie-legal: OK to submit evidence. On credit: only if customer provides written pause of dispute.

elaine-finance: Plan: 1) submit redacted evidence to issuer today. 2) hold payouts. 3) offer conditional $300 credit if customer pauses dispute in writing. Trevor, submit and tag me when done.

trevor-payments: Will submit within the hour and post confirmation id here.

fraud-alert-bot: Case logged CB-2026-9901.

elaine-finance: Thanks team, keep updates in-thread.
